name: Yoga Community Weekend Gathering
summary: Weekend gathering for up to 70 yoga people, a few group practices, lots of free time and talking, no teacher, moderate. $240.
description:
Come join us for our Yoga Community Weekend Gathering, an amazing weekend of yoga, community and connection in the beautiful Hill Country!!!

The gathering is for anyone who has a yoga practice and wants to spend a weekend with other yoga people. There is no teacher, its a community gathering not a workshop, we practice together in the morning (group practice at 7am, everyone leads a bit, self led) and again at 5pm, and the rest of the time is free, hang out, swim, talk, share, its a very social weekend, lots of talking and connecting, thats really the point of it, connection.

Its a moderate weekend physically, the group practices are about 90 mins and there's hiking if you want but nothing crazy.

You should have a practice already (some experience) because the group practices are self led and we dont teach, but you dont have to be advanced at all.

Up to 70 people, camping and bunkhouse. $240 includes food and camping.

Cant wait to see you all there!!!
practical: Friday to Sunday, spring and fall. $240 including meals and camping/bunkhouse. Up to 70. Bring your mat, tent or bedding, swimsuit, hiking shoes. Between Austin and San Antonio, directions after booking. Wifi at the lodge.
